items.headline: O: $122B committed capital at $852B post-money valuation
items.summary: O says it closed a latest funding round with $122B committed capital and $852B post-money valuation; also expands a revolving credit facility to about $4.7B and cites rapid product usage growth.

items.headline: G: $350M Series A; valuation $3.5B; 200+MW by 2027
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive (NVIDIA planned participation), valuing it at $3.5B. It says it runs 13 data centers and expects to scale from 54MW to 200+MW in 2027.
